title: LakeQuest: A Three-Domain Benchmark for Grounded Question Answering across Data Lakes
abstract: arXiv:2607.12310v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While modern question answering (QA) systems excel on clean, schema-aligned corpora, real-world knowledge is rarely so neatly packaged. Answering questions over enterprise and scientific data lakes requires systems to navigate heterogeneous, weakly structured collections of tables, passages, and linked metadata. Current benchmarks abstract away this noisy discovery process, failing to evaluate end-to-end performance. To bridge this gap, we introduce LakeQuest, a human-validated benchmark of 9,846 QA pairs designed to evaluate the end-to-end retrieve-and-synthesize pipeline over realistic data lakes. LakeQuest spans three diverse domains (AI/ML metadata, retail banking, and multimodal biomedical drug information) and pairs every question with exact, modality-aware evidence pointers. translated_title: LakeQuest：面向数据湖中基于证据的问答的三域基准测试
translated_abstract: 虽然现代问答（QA）系统在干净、模式对齐的语料库上表现出色，但现实世界的知识很少如此整齐地打包。回答企业和科学数据湖上的问题，要求系统能够导航异构、弱结构化的表、段落和关联元数据集合。当前基准测试忽略了这种嘈杂的发现过程，未能评估端到端性能。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了LakeQuest，一个经过人工验证的基准测试，包含9,846个问答对，旨在评估现实数据湖上的端到端检索与综合流程。LakeQuest覆盖三个不同领域（AI/ML元数据、零售银行和多模态生物医学药物信息），并将每个问题与精确的、模态感知的证据指针配对。通过将源发现与跨模态综合分离，LakeQuest揭示了现代QA系统中的关键失败模式。我们的基线评估结果（部分省略）显示其有效性。
tldr: LakeQuest是一个包含9,846个问答对、覆盖三个领域的人工验证基准，用于评估数据湖中端到端的检索与综合问答流程，并揭示现代系统的关键失败模式。
en_tdlr: LakeQuest is a human-validated benchmark with 9,846 QA pairs across three domains, evaluating end-to-end retrieve-and-synthesize pipelines over data lakes and exposing critical failure modes in modern QA systems.
